# MoviesParty

> Free watch party for movies with friends. Create a room, share the code and press play together, with synced playback, voice, video and chat.

MoviesParty is a watch party service: create a room, share the room code, and everyone presses play at the same time. It does not host movies; each person plays their own copy or subscription and MoviesParty syncs the playhead.
